Severin Safari Camp | Unforgettable Safari Adventures in Tsavo West
book your stay MENU
book your stay MENU
Adventure Kenya
Being connected with the great Kenyan wild nature, experience the unique play of colours of dawn and dusk, listening to the voices of the wilderness, being at peace with yourself – all this and so much more is offered by Severin Safari Camp.
Come as a guest,
leave as a friend.
Inspired by nature & calmness
Amidst Tsavo West National Park we have created a place that reflects the deep bond with the country like nothing else.
Season
All year
Location
Tsavo West Nationalpark
Open Camp
Experience nature with no barriers
Panorama
Untouched beauty, Kilimanjaro on the horizon
Luxury Tents & Suites
Experience our elegantly furnished tents and suits, blending African style with stunning views of the open wilderness and Kilimanjaro.

The Luxury Tents offer a perfect blend of comfort and immersion in nature. Each tent is designed with handmade wooden furniture in a traditional African style, providing an authentic and cozy atmosphere. With a private veranda, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding savanna, where wildlife roams freely. Each tent comes with an en-suite bathroom, running hot and cold water, and a shower, ensuring a comfortable stay while still experiencing the wild beauty of Tsavo. The tents are ideal for those seeking an intimate connection with nature without compromising on comfort.

The Junior Suites provide extra space and comfort, perfect for families or couples seeking a more luxurious safari experience. Each suite features a separate lounge area and a private courtyard with an outdoor shower, offering privacy and a connection to nature. The spacious bathrooms include double washbasins and large windows that let in natural light, enhancing the tranquil ambiance. From your private sun deck, enjoy the beauty of the African wilderness, and relax in the serene surroundings. The suite includes a 1.40m couch and a foldable bed, making it suitable for children or, in total, a comfortable family room. These suites offer the perfect blend of luxury and nature, ensuring an unforgettable stay in the heart of Tsavo.
LEARN MORE

The Executive Suites, Kibo and Mawenzi, offer an elevated safari experience with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro and the vast savanna of Tsavo. Each suite features a raised observation deck with sun loungers, perfect for relaxing while taking in the breathtaking landscape. Inside, the spacious suite is fitted with a king-size bed, luxurious tent canvas, and a corner bathtub for added comfort. Families can enjoy the option of an adjacent connecting Luxury Tent, making the suite ideal for larger groups or those seeking extra space. The connecting Luxury Tent is available for an additional charge and must be booked separately. Guests booking the Executive Suite also benefit from complimentary tea and coffee-making facilities, as well as a first-fill minibar.
LEARN MORE

Room size

m²
Max occupancy
3 Adults
From

/ per night
The Kitani Bandas offer an authentic safari experience, located about 1.5 kilometers from the main camp. A vehicle is required to reach the Bandas, as the route is not walkable. Each Banda features a kitchenette equipped with a fridge, small gas cookers, sink, and essential utensils like plates, cutlery, and glasses. The 6 sqm bathroom includes a shower, toilet, and towels, with running hot and cold water. The 25 sqm sleeping area can accommodate up to three beds, each provided with duvet covers and mosquito nets.
Relax on your private, covered veranda overlooking a personal campfire, perfect for wildlife watching. Free Wi-Fi is available, and guests are welcome to use the pool and gym at the main camp. Private parking is available next to each Banda, and a room steward is on hand to assist. You also have access to the reception, restaurant, bar, and spa at Severin Safari Camp, some with an additional charge.
LEARN MORE
Culinary highlights under the African sun
At Severin Safari Camp, embark on a culinary journey that will delight your senses and make your stay unforgettable. Our "Out of Africa" Restaurant offers a diverse selection of dishes prepared with fresh, regional ingredients and served in a unique atmosphere.
We serve breakfast buffet as well as à la carte lunch and dinner in our “Out of Africa” Restaurant
The chef’s speciality is marinated meat from the Kenyan highlands served on hot stone or as a fondue, in addition we serve fresh vegetables, salad and herbs. Extraordinary wines complete the culinary experience amidst the bush.
We also invite our guests to enjoy the wonderful African atmosphere during a private bush breakfast or bush lunch or to admire the beautiful sunset at Poacher’s Lookout with sparkling wine and canapés (surcharge).

About Severin Safari Camp | Experience Kenya’s Rich Wildlife and Luxury
book your stay MENU
Rooted in history, growing towards tomorrow
The story of Severin Safari Camp began with a vision: to create a space where nature s beauty meets the warmth of Kenyan hospitality, a place where every guest could find peace and excitement in the luxury of the African wilderness without losing the essence of Africa.
Our founder, inspired by their own love for Kenya s rich culture and breathtaking landscapes, laid down the roots of this vision in the early 2000s. Today, Severin Safari Camp stands as a testament to their dream, continually evolving to meet the future with sustainable practices and innovative hospitality.
Sustainability: our promise to the planet
At Severin Safari Camp we practice the principles of ecological tourism. We have therefore developed a program to protect the fragile ecosystem of the park and contribute to eco-friendliness. It is important for us to also teach our guests about the environment and natural protection during a “Back of the House” tour.
Fresh water is brought to Severin Safari Camp by using our own pipeline which comes directly from Mzima Springs. Hot water is made using solar energy and heat recovery of the power generators. Severin Safari Camp was the first camp to possess a waste water treatment plant which cleans the entire waste water from the tents and the kitchen.
A community at heart
Our connection with the local community is at the core of who we are. The Severin Craftsman Training Center in Mombasa is our pride, offering training and employment opportunities to the local youth, ensuring that the benefits of tourism are shared widely and ethically.
Through these efforts, we strive to empower our community, fostering a future where everyone grows together.
Unforgettable experiences for every guest
From the tranquility of our Kenbali Spa to the adventure of our curated safaris, every aspect of Severin Safari Camp is designed with your experience in mind.
Whether you re soaking up the sun by our pool, observing animals at the waterholes from our open-sided restaurant, or participating in our bush walks and game drives, we re here to ensure your stay is nothing short of magical.

Severin Safari Camp | Location & Contact Information
book your stay MENU
Our Severin Safari Camp can be reached by scheduled flights from the airports of Mombasa and Nairobi Wilson or with private charter flights. The nearest airstrips are Finch Hattons and Kilaguni (both located about 30 minutes away from the camp), which are served daily by Safarilink from Nairobi Wilson and by Mombasa Air Safaris from Mombasa. Charter flights with the luxurious Cessna Caravan of Scenic Air Safaris are available on request.
You can also reach the camp with local busses or by train from Mombasa or Nairobi. The comfortable Madaraka Express will take you daily to Mtito Andei. From there you will be picked up after prior request. And you will find us also by car, the camp is located about 250 km away from both Mombasa and Nairobi. The coordinates are as follows: Latitude (S 2° 59′ 54,54”) and longitude (E 37° 59′ 07,51”).
